notes.title: 1.4 Update and some story
notes.content:
Hey, remember me?

Finally, update 1.4 has arrived, and we have reached a very important milestone for this game!!! It's been 1 year since I started making this game!!! I will make a special post talking about my history as a Game Developer and about the history of this game on my birthday, which will be on 12/19!

But anyway, let's get to the changelog

[h3] --- ChangeLog --- [/h3]
[list]
[*] As always, I fixed several bugs
[*] Game Over screen added, to see how many points you scored in the round and other information as well
[*] Christmas decorations will appear automatically when December arrives, including a Countdown to my birthday
[*] When the game starts, it now has a much cuter animation of the logo of my "Studio", DaniNocchi Studios
[*] I'm planning the date for the game to be free. The goal was for it to be free in this update, but I found out that it is quite difficult to make a game free on Steam, so I need more time for that
[/list]

[h3] --- Mini Story --- [/h3] 
Anyway, I'm having some problems with the game, and I might have to release some frequent mini-updates to solve some small bugs, all because of Microsoft, let me explain:
I started IT High School this year, and this school is sponsored by Microsoft, so we only use Microsoft programs like Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, etc... So, I had to log my OneDrive on my PC, but when I did that, OneDrive started backing up some of my PC folders automatically, including the Steam SDK and my game project. When I tried to recover, my game was missing a bunch of files, GitHub wasn't working, and the Steam SDK stopped working too. I had to get an old backup of my game and work on this old backup, I had to re-download many things in my project, including the Steam SDK, and for some reason, some things still don't work, so I'm trying to make everything work again.

I'll tell more about this story in the special post on my birthday, so that's it, bye!!

See you on December 19.

notes.title: 1.3 UPDATE IS FINALLY HERE!!!
notes.content:
Finally, I released update 1.3, and here I added A LOT OF STUFF and fixed MANY BUGS. Here is the complete changelog:
[list]
[*] The game will be free soon!
[*] Instead of leaving the map and taking damage, now you have a barrier preventing you.
[*] Particles have been added to some things.
[*] Many bugs have been fixed, which I won’t list here.
[*] Some things, like your old death count, have been reset because I redid the save system from scratch.
[*] The system for changing the name on the scoreboard has been completely redone from scratch, for aesthetics and to be able to work with mobile in the future.
[*] New power-up added, the +1, which recovers 1 of your lives.
[*] New achievement added: if you press a very well-known set of keys, the game will bug and crash!
[*] 
[/list]
I gave up on making the skin system because it was very difficult to do and would take a lot of time, so [i]maybe[/i] in the future I’ll do it, but I can’t guarantee it.

Anyway, I added a lot of stuff. Enjoy! Soon I’ll release the Halloween update. Stay tuned, bye.

notes.title: Update Status (26/09/2024)
notes.content:
Hello again.

It’s been a while since I last updated the game, right? I’m working on the new update and, believe me, there’s A LOT COMING!!!

Here are some of the new features:

[list]
[*] Particles to beautify the game
[*] A new DLC skin
[*] Some features completely redone from scratch (like the save system)
[/list]
Among other things.

Another incredible piece of news is that when I release this update, the game will be FREE!!!

There are still things I haven’t started yet, others I’ve already finished, but I believe I’m halfway there. I didn’t want to set a date because I hardly have time to work on the game. I just started high school and the schedule is very tight. But for those who are anxious, I’ll try to release this update in November, maybe October if I can work at my maximum.

Thank you for reading this far and enjoy a good journey, breaking meteors out there! Bye!!

notes.title: 1.2.1 Update
notes.content:
Hey, it's been a while, right? I've been working on developing my own dialogue system, something I could never get to work before, even with external scripts. But now, I finally managed to make it happen! This update is quite small considering how long I've been away, but here are the changelogs:

[olist]
[*] Removed the Changelog Button: With the Steam News system now in place, it no longer makes sense to keep it.
[*] Added a Fullscreen Button: Remember when you accidentally clicked outside the game or closed it by mistake? Not anymore!
[*] Steam Cloud Save System: Now you can play the game on another device using the same account!
[/olist]

That's all for now. I hope you enjoy the updates. I'm currently developing the shop system, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Update status (21/07/2024)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I'm currently working on version 1.2.1 of the game, and I really want to hear from you. What features or changes would you like to see? I'm open to any suggestions, so please leave your ideas in the comments below.

New Features:
[list]
[*] Added a fullscreen button in the options menu.
[*] Working on the Skin Store system. I'm waiting to receive my first payment from Steam to purchase the GM Live plugin, which will help in developing the Store system.
[/list]

Also, i've developing my own dialogue system for the first time, that's why its been a while since I've worked on Space Shooter.

That's all for now. I'll try to release the latest update as soon as possible. Thank you for your support and for reading!

Best,
DaniNocchi
